meta.exclude_from_evaluation: every id in items[feature]['mine'|'select'] (all items are freshly generated and disjoint from 02's wrap/prose pickles).
meta.procedure: D9 item 6: mined on a held-out MINING split (k=8 free readouts per item: NLA@42 iter_000400, OL s3d-rl600 @42/40/44 pooled; J-Lens n1000 top-50 @42), LLM-assisted extraction (Gemini 3.8 Flash), selected by natural-item paired log-odds AUROC on a disjoint SELECTION split at the primary layer (42), before any steering run.
meta.scoring: NLA: candidate after '<explanation>\n'; OL: candidate as the first '- ' bullet (prefix ''); J-Lens: max cosine score over single-token variants, s(a)-s(b). Both candidates of an activation share one forward batch. LO = log p(value_a) - log p(value_b) with value_a = FEATURES[f]['values'][0]; AUROC vs label (true == a).
